Model card: **Duo-1.0-causal-base** **A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction** Model Overview Duo is a full-duplex multimodal world model for real-time audio-visual interaction. This repository contains the Duo 1.0 causal-base model weights. | Field | Value | | --- | --- | | Version | Duo 1.0 | | Variant | Causal base | | Package | Complete model bundle | | Realization format | PyTorch Distributed Checkpoint (DCP) | | Default sampler | Euler, 50 steps, flow shift 1.0 | Package Contents The bundle contains the Realization weights and backbone, Intent model and adapter, video and audio codecs, speech recognizer, and forced aligner. Runtime integrations can use to identify the packaged model family and weight format. Download For code, configuration, and runtime-specific integration instructions, see inclusionAI/Duo. License These weights were initialized from MiniMax H3 and subsequently trained by the Duo team. See LICENSE and NOTICE for the applicable terms.
